summary: Declare the inputs of the linux-gate evidence check (shadow only: enforce stays false), so a pull request that touches none of them would reuse the note of a tree on which the gate passed

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes the evidence skip policy (read from the accepted base) and a test.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. With enforce false nothing is skipped: the gate records match=inputs lines for linux-gate and the real jobs still run.

recovery.detail: No recovery procedure; reverting the policy hunk restores exact-tree matching for linux-gate.
